text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling stocks at substantial losses and later buying Stock B back at a higher price showed me the cost of reacting without a clear, consistent plan; I should set decision rules before trading.","Several months of account fluctuations are too little evidence to judge long-run skill. I should evaluate results over time against the overall market, while keeping risk in view.","I should make each trade based on current prospects and portfolio balance—not my average cost, recent account movements, or a wish to make back losses."]}
